identity.title: Move Signal Inspector TSV export behind the existing Tool composition boundary

origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that remaining Tool/Learn Partial responsibilities be corrected structurally.

state.current_summary: VisionToolSignalInspectorView의 TSV file-I/O 직접 호출을 명시적 exporter action seam으로 이동했다. 기존 SaveFileDialog presentation, evidence/marker/XAML 계약, 세 Tool View lifetime은 유지했고 기존 VisionToolSignalEvidenceExporter가 파일 출력 owner로 남았다. Debug/Release source contract/build, Tool WPF smoke, readiness, structural/documentation/diff checks가 통과했으며 native dialog click과 전체 UI/native 행렬은 미검증으로 남겼다.

objective.summary: Remove the concrete TSV file-export call from the required VisionToolSignalInspectorView XAML Partial and route it through the existing Tool composition owners without changing SaveFileDialog presentation, evidence state, or Tool View lifetime.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Reuse VisionToolSignalEvidenceExporter and existing Threshold/Simple Preprocess/Line Tool composition; do not add a service, interface, manager, event bus, wrapper, or Partial.
Preserve VisionToolSignalInspectorView XAML names, automation IDs, marker event, ShowEvidence/ClearEvidence/test facades, and SaveFileDialog owner behavior.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current and intended owners, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public contract, shortest reading order, and matching test.

VisionToolSignalInspectorView no longer references VisionToolSignalEvidenceExporter directly; all known production Tool XAML parents configure the existing exporter action, and UI/test export paths share the same seam.

Focused Debug/Release contracts and builds, relevant WPF smoke, readiness, structural audit, documentation index, issue validation, and diff checks pass; native SaveFileDialog interaction and full UI/native matrices are explicitly unverified.

milestones.summary: Inventory Signal Inspector callers, evidence state, exporter, dialog, binding, and lifetime owners.
Replace direct Inspector-to-exporter calls with the explicit action seam and wire all known production Tool composition owners.
Run focused source/build/WPF smoke proof and record durable evidence.

evidence.observation: The Inspector retains evidence, plot/marker presentation, XAML contract, and SaveFileDialog, while its direct exporter call is replaced by an explicit action. All three known production Tool parents wire the existing TSV exporter; evidence mutable state and Tool View lifetime remain in their existing owners.
SignalInspectorExportBoundaryContract passed 6/6 in Debug and Release; the contract proves seam wiring, direct-coupling removal, existing exporter ownership, and the shared UI/test export path.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke and OpenVisionLab.sln Debug/Release builds passed with 0 warnings/errors; PipelineViewerScreenshotSmoke x64 Debug passed with 0 errors and three pre-existing warnings; single-monitor WPF Tool smoke produced fresh PNG evidence; readiness, RefactorAudit, DocumentationIndex, JSON parse, and diff checks passed. Native dialog interaction and full UI/native matrices remain unverified.

events.summary: Signal Inspector는 required XAML Partial이므로 제거하지 않는다. SaveFileDialog는 View-specific presentation으로 유지하되, file-I/O를 직접 호출할 이유는 없으므로 기존 exporter를 Action<VisionToolSignalEvidence, string>으로 연결하고 UI/test path를 같은 seam에 둔다.
PL-0035의 세 completion criteria와 세 milestone이 현재 증거로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. Native SaveFileDialog click/file association, 전체 theme/DPI/input 행렬, hardware/native runtime은 이 slice의 검증 범위가 아니다.

The direct Inspector-to-exporter coupling was removed, all known production Tool composition wiring was verified, and focused source/build/runtime evidence was recorded. Do not reopen this boundary without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency boundary.
